title: Mouthful of Dub
description: A talking formant dub bass: a sawtooth core dropped two octaves into c2/c3 register, mouthed through stepped vowels on prime-ish periods so it seems to speak, with a perlin-driven band-pass journey and a subtle vibrato. Drenched in a cavernous dub room and a dotted delay throw so each phrase trails off into the cave.
code:
setcpm(70/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 [c2 d2] f2 eb2>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o>/3 <u a o e>/7 <i o a u>/11")
    .vib(perlin.range(0.15, 0.6).slow(13)).vibmod(0.4)
    .bpf(perlin.range(180, 1300).slow(23))
    .bpq(tri.range(6, 13).slow(11))
    .lpf(2200)
    .shape(0.28)
    .room(perlin.range(0.5, 0.85).slow(29)).roomsize(7)
    .delay("0.45:0.5:0.72").delayfb(0.7)
    .orbit(2)
    .gain(0.85),
  note("c1").s("sine")
    .gain(saw.range(0.2, 0.38).slow(16))
    .lpf(140)
)
